    LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents.rayArrowRepresentative_mem_radical_composite_span_false

    Irreducible BGRS rays do not come from radical composites #

    An irreducible unit ray cannot lie in the principal two-sided span of a nonzero composite of two ambient-radical corner morphisms. The proof uses the special BGRS product and nilpotence of local Jacobson radicals.
